name: Sandy's Way Microfarm
price: Prepaid credit: $300 (gets $330), $500 ($550), $700 ($770); Table Member $1,500 ($1,650+, limited to 15)

evidence.quote_or_summary: Harvest Member tiers and Table Member

notes: Not a fixed-share CSA: Harvest Membership is prepaid credit with 10% discount, credits never expire, year-round, shop weekly harvest. Homepage also lists Castle Rock Farmers Market (Douglas County Fairgrounds) Saturdays June 13 - Oct 3, 2026 (market sales; not confirmed as membership pickup). Directory text mentions 7 pickup locations but only the farm was listed on fetched pages. SNAP not mentioned.
